lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in a multi-row horizontal and vertical grid pattern posterior to the gills, with larger, more widely spaced blobs along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a localized grid-like structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal carinae are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 high-luminance blobs are distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch is visible on the posterior-superior edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-density clustering of small punctate spots on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits; presence of three remoras attached to the ventral flank area.
